items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: And when he hired the band, he wanted a Dixieland band. Cause he knew me.

ctx.x: The final piece was most extreme. Second real of the band.

Then I had, I called it a banjo. One of the last I could get a guitar player, I called it a banjo player. Willie. Willie Van Teese. Oh yeah. Got him two banjos. Two banjos in your band. Yeah, two banjos. Sound good too. Willie had a good, real good banjo. Cause we was playing down on France Street. A fellow by the name of Jimmy Duport. But he couldn't get nobody in the place. Honestly they had a lot of sisters hanging that place, you know? Oh I see. And when he hired the band, he wanted a Dixieland band. Cause he…
we're going to go to the table. We're going to the Donalstonville.
